# 2 Baruch Chapter 60 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 60:1 — escalating sin pattern

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "they-were-worse-than-the-sins-which-the-first-generation-had-sinned" |
| LOGOS | "they were worse than the sins which the first generation had sinned" |
| PNEUMA | "sins even worse than what the first generation had done" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The relative clause structure in the Syriac ('which the first generation had sinned') is important for the escalating typology of the twelve waters; LOGOS preserves it.

---

## 60:2 — works of their hands

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "went-after-the-works-of-their-hands" |
| LOGOS | "went after the works of their hands" |
| PNEUMA | "went after their own handiwork" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Works of their hands' is a standard biblical idiom for idols (cf. Deut 31:29); PNEUMA's 'handiwork' loses this conventional phrase.

---
